Business to Business
(B2B)

We work with selected African companies including startups and SMEs seeking business opportunities or expansion to Europe through strategic partnerships.

Business to Government (B2G)

We help established European companies seeking partnerships with state actors or relevant public agencies in Africa.

Government to Government (G2G)

We facilitate collaboration between African government agencies seeking technical and financial collaboration from relevant public institutions in Europe.

About us

We are bridging cross border partnerships

We support organizations to expand to new markets leveraging on strategic partnerships across various sectors. Our understanding of the European and African business ecosystem positions us to help our clients gain an edge in fostering successful cross border partnerships. We are located in Paris with an affiliate office in Abuja, (Nigeria).

Our Services

At Bridge and Value, we pride ourselves on offering a diverse range of services aimed at fostering global connections and maximizing opportunities. From strategic partnerships to innovative solutions, our services bridge gaps and add lasting value to businesses and organizations worldwide.

International Business Development
